description: ASCII punctuation test: a printable non-space character that is neither a letter nor a digit (ispunct)
notes: musl 1.2.5, ispunct (src/ctype/ispunct.c), with isgraph, isalnum, isalpha and isdigit inlined from their own files in src/ctype (each a single range test). Written by us from the functions. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps a branch on the isgraph range test, then two range compares, a select and a zext: 13 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
